subject: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sparkscale.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount details

Thanks again for the conversation this morning, Alex — great to learn more about SparkScale's retrieval and reranking workload. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Traffic profile: mostly real-time chat-based inference for end-user queries, peak concurrency ~150 rps, median request length ~120 tokens, expected annual growth 3x.
- Estimated monthly tokens (prompt+response): conservative 80M, expected 200M with growth and new features.
- Key asks: a) target unit cost around $1,000 / 1M tokens for the long-term production path, b) startup-friendly pricing for the first 12 months while you scale, c) ability to commit to a 12-month committed-use contract for a deeper discount.

I asked for the usage CSV you mentioned — if you can send that, we'll run a quick unit-economics calc and propose two pricing options (startup program and committed-use tiers) with expected $/1M token.

Attachments: - Redwood_Startup_Program_T&Cs.pdf (baseline terms)

Next steps:
1) If you can send the month-by-month usage estimates (CSV) today, I'll loop in our pricing ops and get back with numbers by tomorrow EOD.
2) If the committed-use path looks right, we can prepare a draft order form and a DocuSign link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sparkscale.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T12:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount details

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. Quick answers and the CSV attached: SparkScale_usage_estimates.csv (monthly breakdown, conservative & aggressive).

A few clarifications:
- The 80M -> 200M range is accurate for months 1-12 (conservative vs. expected). By month 12 we expect ~180-220M/month under the aggressive model.
- Budget range: for the first 12 months, our procurement team has an initial allocation of ~$30k-$75k total (startup credit + seed funding). If we commit to a 12-month contract, we can consider a $300k committed-use + monthly smoothing.
- Target unit economics: we're aiming for $800-$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on SLA and support. The lower end ($800/1M) requires a deeper committed-use discount + startup incentives.

Can Redwood do: startup program discount for months 1-6, then a tiered committed discount for months 7-12 if we hit volume milestones? Also curious about multi-year incentives if we sign a 2-year plan.

Attachment: SparkScale_usage_estimates.csv (attached)

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Head of ML Ops | SparkScale
alex.kim@sparkscale.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sparkscale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount details

Appreciate the CSV, Alex — that helps a lot. Quick pull-together of options based on the conservative/aggressive curves you sent. Below are two pragmatic options we typically offer for startups scaling toward committed use. Numbers below are indicative — final pricing will be confirmed after internal review and legal/order-form processing.

Option A — Startup program (short-term ramp)
- Months 1-6: 60% off list (startup credit modeled as 60% off unit price), applied as monthly credits.
- Months 7-12: transition to list price minus 20% if volume thresholds (>=120M/mo) are hit.
- Effective blended $/1M tokens (aggressive growth path): approx $900-$1,050 / 1M tokens.
- No minimum committed spend; ideal if cash upfront is limited.

Option B — 12-month committed-use (best unit economics)
- Commit $300k for 12 months (prepaid or monthly invoiced).
- Discount: 15% off list baseline + additional volume banding up to 30% for >150M/mo sustained.
- Effective blended $/1M tokens: $700-$900 / 1M tokens depending on banding and support tier.
- Optionally add a 6-month startup credit (40% off) at the front of the term to smooth onboarding.

Multi-year incentive (2-year): we can extend an additional 5-10% off committed pricing if you sign 24-months and pre-commit to a growth path with checkpoints.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben (cc'd) — can you confirm if we can approve a 60% startup credit (Option A) and whether the 15% baseline + banding up to 30% on Option B fits within current pricing decks and our startup program guardrails?
- Alex — if you can confirm which option you want to pursue (A or B or a hybrid), we'll draft an order form and include the startup T&Cs.

Attachments: Redwood_Startup_Program_T&Cs.pdf (baseline), sample order form template (internal)

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount details

Marissa — confirmed. Per sales ops and the Startup Program policy we can approve Option A (60% startup credit months 1-6) for SparkScale. For Option B (12-month committed $300k): baseline 15% off with banding up to 30% for >150M/mo sustained is within our allowed tiers; we'll need revenue ops signoff on the exact band thresholds in the order form but ✅ in principle.

One caveat: multi-year extra discounts (5-10%) require VP approval for >10% uplift on effective discount. If SparkScale is targeting the 2-year path, we should surface projected ARR and strategic signals to justify the extra.

I'll prep a short internal note for revenue ops and legal to accelerate the order-form. Marissa — feel free to share the CSV and the two-option summary with Alex and request confirmation which path he prefers.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@sparkscale.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed use & startup discount details

This all looks great — thanks for the quick turn, Marissa and Ben. We'd like to proceed with a hybrid approach:

- Months 1-6: Startup credits as Option A (60% off) to conserve cash during initial ramp.
- Months 7-12: Move to committed-use with a $300k 12-month commit (Option B) with baseline 15% off + banding. If we hit >=150M/mo sustained, apply the higher band up to 30%.
- We're open to the 2-year discussion but want to see month 1-6 ramp and month 7 telemetry before committing.

Next steps for Redwood: please send a draft order form + DocuSign once revenue ops/legal confirm band thresholds. I've attached a quick PO timeline and internal procurement notes (SparkScale_PO_timeline.docx). We target an internal sign-off window of 2-3 weeks.

Attachment: SparkScale_PO_timeline.docx

If you want, I can also loop procurement on the DocuSign once you have the order form ready. Looking forward to the draft.

Best,
Alex
Head of ML Ops | SparkScale
alex.kim@sparkscale.ai
